consensus_summary: Fans overwhelmingly praise the performance of the Grateful Dead at the 1973-02-19 show, highlighting the exceptional jamming and the standout songs. Many agree that the He's Gone > Truckin' > Other One > Eyes > China Doll sequence is particularly remarkable, showcasing the band's musical synergy and improvisational skills.
